title: SuperHi – Creative Coding Education
description: SuperHi is a colorful, creative education platform with a playful design that breaks away from standard edtech conventions. Uses custom illustration style and vibrant pastel palette that feels warm and approachable. The hero features animated creative coding examples that demonstrate what students will learn. Course cards use thumbnails with progress indicators and skill levels. The page uses generous whitespace with centered layouts and a friendly, encouraging tone. Teacher profiles include real photos with bio snippets. The color palette of warm pastels — coral, mint, yellow, lavender — creates an inviting, non-intimidating feel perfect for a creative learning audience.
primary_use_case: Live design inspiration for educational platforms and creative tools that want a warm, approachable, illustrated page design.
style_vibe: Playful, pastel-colored creative education page with custom illustrations and a warm, welcoming visual language.
